On Wed, Jun 17, 2025 at 11:04 AM rafael.mendes@redwoodai.com wrote:
> I attached our baseline SOW with a placeholder clause and a new draft Exhibit C (v2) that separates the entries.

Rafael — drafting language below for SOW §3.2 that should satisfy Lumina's ask while keeping Redwood's data handling commitments narrow. Please review and confirm you want this exact wording, then I can move it into the docx redline:

"Data & Telemetry Retention: Customer telemetry and usage logs generated from Redwood-hosted inference for the Lumina account will be retained for a period of twenty-four (24) months from the date of generation, unless otherwise required by law or agreed in writing. Retention does not include cached model internal states (KV cache) which are ephemeral and not stored beyond active request processing. Aggregated, anonymized usage metrics may be retained indefinitely for Redwood's service analytics."

Notes: 1) I explicitly excluded KV cache to prevent scope creep. 2) If Lumina wants shorter retention for certain data classes, we can add an exhibit table.

Karthik — pricing split still needed. Neha, can you confirm whether this carve-out would trigger any changes in our usual DPA or compliance checklist?
